description: Search open defensive cybersecurity jobs (SOC, incident response, DFIR, threat hunting, CTI, detection and security engineering) on BlueTeamJobs. Newest first. Each result links to the job page, where the user applies.

clearance.description: "none" for jobs without a clearance, "any" for any clearance, or a specific level.

location.description: City, US state, state code or country, e.g. "Virginia", "VA", "austin-tx", "Canada".

min_salary.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD; only jobs that publish pay match.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, company, description and skills.

role.description: Role slug or name, e.g. "soc-analyst". See list_roles.

name: search_jobs
title: Search blue team jobs
